entities.summary: Li Kwoh-ting was a Chinese economist and politician best known as the "Father of Taiwan's Economic Miracle" and referred to by the New York Times as the "Godfather of Technology" in Taiwan for his work in transforming Taiwan's economy from an agrarian-based system into one of the world's leading producers of information and telecommunications technology. His career spanned some 40 years, working for the Kuomintang government both before and after its defeat and subsequent retreat to Taiwan. His contributions continue to make him one of the most revered figures in Taiwanese history to this day.

historicalSignificance.significanceNarrative: Kwoh-Ting Li's economic policies transformed Taiwan into one of the world's leading producers of information and telecommunications technology, earning him the title of 'Father of Taiwan's Economic Miracle'. His work had a significant impact on the country's development and continues to shape its economy today.
